Triage: lands in `examples/app-crm/src/security/sales-positions.ts` — the subsystem this example exercises is the permission-set/security model, same lane as its sibling #8060 ⇒ `domain:identity`, type Bug, `pm:queue`. The platform's own build lint (`security-master-detail-ungranted`) both flags the defect and prescribes the fix, and the live `objectstack verify --rls` run confirms every position persona probe-blocked on exactly this object.

Size/model suggestion: S mechanical / sonnet. Acceptance: the build warning disappears and the same `verify --rls` run shows the line-item object resolving for the sales positions (grant shape matching the parent `crm_opportunity`, `allowDelete: false` as suggested). No dependency: #8060's fix is already on main per the card's measurement.
